_meta.purpose: Comprehensive GPS-tagged inventory of access points, impassable dams, and USGS gauges for every Colorado-river corridor in Flow-State. Compiled from 5 parallel research agents using American Whitewater, BLM, USFS, CPW, USGS NWIS, OpenStreetMap, and Wikipedia. Each entry includes a `_confidence` field (high/medium/low) and a `source` field with citations. Lat/lon set to null where no authoritative source confirms a precise pin — better null than wrong.
_meta.review_required: Walk each river's accessPoints[] in upstream→downstream order. Confirm names, kinds, coords, and any missing intermediate APs. Note: riverMile is NOT yet populated — Phase 9 (compute-river-miles.ts) will snap each lat/lon to USGS NHDPlus flowlines and compute cumulative river-mile from the corridor head.
confidence_values: high (USGS NWIS site, BLM/CPW/USFS page, OSM slipway with explicit name)
medium (boater knowledge / town centroid / inferred from MP)
low (general location only, may need on-the-ground verification)
ark_specific_corrections_from_research: Hecla Junction (38.65185, -106.05127) and Ruby Mountain (38.75221, -106.07085) are CONFIRMED distinct sites ~12 km apart with Browns Canyon between them — split the current 'Hecla Junction (or Ruby Mountain)' AP.
Stone Bridge (38.61153, -106.06339) is the BOTTOM of Browns Canyon; the existing 'Stone Bridge / Fisherman's Bridge' string conflates two sites.
Existing gauge usgs-07086000 'at Granite' has WRONG longitude in seed (-106.437 puts it on Turquoise Lake; correct is -106.26586).
Existing gauge usgs-07087050 is mislabeled 'near Wellsville' — it's actually 'below Granite' at Numbers Launch. True Wellsville gauge is 07093700 (a different site, not in current seed).
Existing gauge usgs-07091200 is mislabeled 'at Salida' — it's actually 'near Nathrop' (at Hecla Junction). True Salida gauge is 07091500 (a different site, not in current seed).

accessPoints.notes: ADA-accessible river access in south Durango. Two ramps (tube + trailer).

accessPoints.name: Bondad Bridge
accessPoints.notes: US-550 bridge ~15.5 mi downstream of Dallabetta. Animas flows through Southern Ute / private land between — Bondad is the only legal mid-run access.

accessPoints.name: Cedar Hill (NM)
accessPoints.notes: Just south of CO/NM line. USGS Cedar Hill gauge anchors.

gauges.name: Animas River at Howardsville
gauges.notes: Existing. Headwaters ~4 mi NE of Silverton.

gauges.name: Animas River at Tall Timber above Tacoma
Animas River near Cedar Hill, NM

dolores._summary: Dolores below McPhee Dam through Slick Rock Canyon (Bradfield→Bedrock) and Gateway Canyon (Bedrock→Gateway) to Dewey Bridge UT. Entirely dam-release dependent; often only days-weeks of boatable flow per year. 8 APs, 1 impassable mainstem dam (McPhee), 4 gauges.

accessPoints.name: McPhee Dam outlet (Bradfield area)
accessPoints.notes: Dam coordinates. Actual paddleable put-in downstream at Bradfield. ALL releases below the dam dictate flow.

accessPoints.name: Bradfield Bridge
accessPoints.notes: BLM Bradfield Rec Site. Boat ramp 1/4 mi downstream of bridge. Primary Slick Rock Canyon launch (47 mi to Slick Rock).

accessPoints.name: Dove Creek Pump Station
accessPoints.notes: Intermediate take-out / put-in between Bradfield and Slick Rock. Approx coords.

accessPoints.name: Slick Rock
accessPoints.notes: Cleared put-in just east of Hwy 141 bridge on private land. Take-out for Bradfield run; put-in for Slick Rock Canyon to Bedrock (48.8 mi).

accessPoints.name: Gypsum Valley (Big Gypsum)
accessPoints.notes: Alt access ~13 mi downriver of Slick Rock (25 road mi via CR 20R).

accessPoints.name: Bedrock
accessPoints.notes: River-left access upstream of CO-90 bridge. Take-out for Slick Rock Canyon; put-in for Paradox/Mesa Canyon to Gateway.

accessPoints.name: Gateway
accessPoints.notes: Put-in/take-out upstream river right of Hwy 141 bridge at Gateway Resort. Put-in for 32-mi run to Dewey (UT).

accessPoints.name: Dewey Bridge (UT)
accessPoints.notes: On Colorado River just downstream of Dolores confluence (Utah). Standard Gateway take-out.
accessPoints.source: BLM Moab Dolores River map; AW reach 389

impassableDams.name: McPhee Dam
impassableDams.notes: USBR (Dolores Project), rolled earth/rockfill, 5,000 cfs outlet. Splits Dolores into a non-floated headwaters reach (above) and the entire downstream corridor (below). ALL releases dictate flow — usually only days-weeks boatable per year.

gauges.name: Dolores River at Dolores, CO
gauges.notes: Town of Dolores, ABOVE McPhee. Reservoir inflow indicator.

gauges.name: Dolores River near Bedrock, CO
gauges.notes: Existing. Distinct from 09169500 — below West Paradox Creek.

gauges.name: Dolores River at Gateway, CO
gauges.notes: NEW. Bottom of Paradox/Mesa; top of Gateway-to-Dewey.

san-miguel._summary: San Miguel from Telluride through Placerville, Norwood Canyon, Naturita, Uravan to Dolores confluence. 8 APs, 0 impassable mainstem dams (3 portage-required diversion dams flagged in notes), 5 gauges (4 new).

accessPoints.name: Telluride Town Park
accessPoints.notes: Top of San Miguel paddleable corridor. Town Park between San Miguel and Bear Creek.

accessPoints.name: Sawpit
accessPoints.notes: Tiny town NW of Telluride on Hwy 145 with BLM stream-bank access.

accessPoints.name: Placerville
accessPoints.notes: Hwy 62/145 jct, elev ~7,320 ft. River becomes navigable here late April / early May.

accessPoints.name: Caddis Flats Boat Ramp
accessPoints.notes: BLM Caddis Flats CG ~1.8 mi west of Placerville on CO-145. Hand-carry launch. Co-located with USGS Placerville gauge.

accessPoints.name: Norwood Bridge
accessPoints.notes: Take-out for Specie Creek to Norwood Bridge; put-in for Norwood Canyon to Naturita. Limited parking.

accessPoints.name: Naturita
accessPoints.notes: Town access — common Norwood Canyon take-out. WARNING: 3 diversion dams between Naturita and the Hwy 145 bridge east of Norwood require portage.

accessPoints.name: Uravan
accessPoints.notes: Former uranium-mill townsite (reclaimed). From Naturita: east Hwy 145, left Hwy 90.

accessPoints.name: Confluence with Dolores
accessPoints.notes: Confluence ~15 mi east of UT line. Paddlers typically continue down Dolores to Gateway. Approx coords.

gauges.name: San Miguel River near Placerville, CO
San Miguel River at Brooks Bridge near Nucla, CO
San Miguel River at Naturita, CO
San Miguel River at Uravan, CO
San Miguel River below Uravan, CO

piedra._summary: Piedra Upper Box (Second Box) and Lower Box (First Box) — short snowmelt season. 4 APs, 0 impassable dams, 1 gauge.

accessPoints.name: Piedra Bridge / Upper Piedra CG
accessPoints.notes: Top put-in for Upper Piedra (Second Box). ~16 mi up Piedra Rd (FR 631) from US-160. Road often closed until mid-May.

accessPoints.name: First Fork Bridge
accessPoints.notes: Mid-river access between Second Box (upper) and First Box (lower). De facto put-in when upper road closed.

accessPoints.name: Lower Piedra Box take-out
accessPoints.notes: Standard take-out below First Box. Near US-160 crossing.

accessPoints.name: Arboles / Navajo Reservoir inflow
accessPoints.notes: Take-out for Class II-III lower stretch from US-160 to Navajo Lake.

gauges.name: Piedra River near Arboles, CO
gauges.notes: Existing. Bottom of Piedra at Navajo Reservoir inflow.

san-juan._summary: San Juan in Colorado — Pagosa Springs town section (whitewater park + Mesa Canyon) to Navajo Reservoir inflow. Below Navajo Dam (in NM) is a separate, famous tailwater. 5 APs, 1 impassable dam (Navajo, just inside NM), 1 gauge.

accessPoints.name: Above Pagosa Springs (Williams Creek)
accessPoints.notes: Williams Creek tributary area NE of Pagosa via US-160 / Williams Creek Rd. Informal upper access in high-water years.

accessPoints.name: Pagosa Springs Town / Yamaguchi Park
accessPoints.notes: Pagosa Springs whitewater park — kayak/raft launch + two WW features adjacent to Riverwalk.

accessPoints.name: Malt Shoppe put-in
accessPoints.notes: WW put-in 'behind the Malt Shoppe' — cited for Pagosa-to-Trujillo run.

accessPoints.name: Trujillo Road take-out
accessPoints.notes: Standard take-out after Mesa Canyon (13.5 mi Class III) on Trujillo / 500 Rd south of Pagosa.

accessPoints.name: Navajo Reservoir inflow (CO)
accessPoints.notes: Where SJ flattens into Navajo Reservoir on CO/NM line. Approx coords.

impassableDams.name: Navajo Dam
impassableDams.notes: USBR (CRSP), 402 ft tall, 1.71 MAF capacity. ~34 mi east of Farmington, NM. Reservoir backs into southern CO. Terminates SJ's CO floatable run. Below the dam (in NM) is the famous Quality Waters tailwater.

gauges.name: San Juan River at Pagosa Springs, CO

clear-creek._summary: Clear Creek from Empire through Idaho Springs / Dumont, Clear Creek Canyon (Tunnel 1, Black Rock, Hells Corner, Mayhem), Golden WW Park, ending at the Coors low-head dam (mandatory take-out). 16 APs, 1 corridor-breaking diversion dam (Coors low-head), 3 gauges.

accessPoints.name: Empire
accessPoints.notes: Expert section above Lawson; West Fork confluence. Spring runoff only.

accessPoints.name: Lawson
accessPoints.notes: Top of Lawson/Dumont section. Prime ~800 cfs.

accessPoints.name: Dumont Put-In
accessPoints.notes: Busy commercial put-in, limited parking, 2.14 mi downstream of Lawson.

accessPoints.name: Lower Dumont Put-In
accessPoints.notes: Preferred private put-in; better parking; cuts ~2 mi of boogie water.

accessPoints.name: Idaho Springs (I-70 / Hwy 103)
accessPoints.notes: Two large lots at I-70/Hwy 103 intersection; primary Dumont take-out.

accessPoints.name: Idaho Springs Town Park
accessPoints.notes: Small free lot, raft ramp; mid-town option.

accessPoints.name: Two Bears (Kermits)
accessPoints.notes: Top of Upper Clear Creek (Kermits) Class IV creeking. Across from Two Bears Tap & Grill.

accessPoints.name: Clear Creek Open Space (Kermits Take-Out)
accessPoints.notes: ~4.4 mi downstream of Two Bears; standard Kermits take-out.

accessPoints.name: Black Rock
accessPoints.notes: Class V; entrance horseshoe hole + back-to-back holes. Hwy 6 pullout.

accessPoints.name: Hells Corner (scout)
accessPoints.notes: Class V rapid in Lower Canyon; commonly scouted from Hwy 6.

accessPoints.name: Mayhem Gulch Trailhead
accessPoints.notes: 32447 US Hwy 6. Major Lower Canyon commercial take-out.

accessPoints.name: Tunnel 1 (above)
accessPoints.notes: 22122 US Hwy 6. Walk down below diversion dam; Class III oxbow around the tunnel.

accessPoints.name: Tunnel 1 (below)
accessPoints.notes: Large dirt pullout east of tunnel; bypasses hardest rapids.

accessPoints.name: Golden Whitewater Park (upper)
accessPoints.notes: North bank across from Lions Park; ~7 city blocks of constructed features.
accessPoints.source: AW Golden Play Park (river-detail/11179); City of Golden

accessPoints.name: Vanover Park
accessPoints.notes: MANDATORY take-out — dangerous low-head dam (Coors diversion) immediately downstream.

accessPoints.name: 6th Avenue / Tucker Gulch
accessPoints.notes: Below Coors diversion; access to lower Clear Creek Trail.

impassableDams.name: Coors / Golden Diversion Dam
impassableDams.notes: Immediately downstream of Vanover Park; dangerous low-head keeper hydraulic. Portageable but corridor-breaking for floaters — Vanover is the mandatory take-out.
impassableDams.source: City of Golden Clear Creek Recreation Guide

gauges.name: Clear Creek above Johnson Gulch near Idaho Springs

cache-la-poudre._summary: Colorado's only Wild & Scenic river. Big South / Narrows / Upper-Lower Mishawaka / Filter Plant commercial run to Fort Collins. 15 APs, 0 impassable mainstem dams (free-flowing through W&S section), 3 gauges.

accessPoints.name: Big South Trailhead
accessPoints.notes: Top of W&S Wild segment; portaged/hiked Class V+ near Hwy 14 MP 73.

accessPoints.name: Spencer Heights / Pingree Park Rd
accessPoints.notes: Upper Narrows access near Hwy 14 MP 96; Class IV-V.

accessPoints.name: Lower Narrows Campground Put-In
accessPoints.notes: USFS walk-in tent CG; start of The Narrows Class V.

accessPoints.name: Upper Narrows Put-In
accessPoints.notes: Hwy 14 pullout, 0.67 mi from Lower Narrows CG.

accessPoints.name: Middle Narrows Put-In
accessPoints.notes: Narrow Hwy 14 pullout.

accessPoints.name: Stevens Gulch Picnic Area
accessPoints.notes: USFS picnic area, Hwy 14 MP 104.7. Take-out for Narrows; put-in for Upper Mishawaka.

accessPoints.name: Upper Landing
accessPoints.notes: Hwy 14 MP 105 alternate launch.

accessPoints.name: Mishawaka Inn
accessPoints.notes: Hwy 14 MP 108.2; private venue access with permission.

accessPoints.name: Dead Deer
accessPoints.notes: Hwy 14 MP 108.8; paved pullout w/ concrete stairs. Upper Mishawaka take-out, Lower Mishawaka put-in.
accessPoints.source: AW Dead Deer to Poudre Park (river-detail/3368)

accessPoints.name: Poudre Park Day Use Area
accessPoints.notes: Hwy 14 MP 110.7; Class III put-in / Lower Mishawaka take-out.

accessPoints.name: Stove Prairie Bridge
accessPoints.notes: CR-27 meets Hwy 14; Filter Plant overflow put-in. USFS Stove Prairie CG nearby.

accessPoints.name: Filter Plant Put-In
accessPoints.notes: Old Fort Collins filtration plant. Start of beginner commercial Class II/III. Day-use only.
accessPoints.source: AW Filter Plant to Picnic Rock (river-detail/372); City of Fort Collins

accessPoints.name: Picnic Rock
accessPoints.notes: Larimer County Open Space; standard Filter Plant take-out, 2.4 mi downstream.

accessPoints.name: Watson Lake State Wildlife Area
accessPoints.notes: CPW SWA below Picnic Rock.

accessPoints.name: Lions Park / Fort Collins
accessPoints.notes: Urban Fort Collins access on Poudre Trail.

gauges.name: Cache la Poudre at Mouth of Canyon near Fort Collins
Cache la Poudre at Fort Collins

south-platte._summary: South Platte: Deckers/Trumbull/Nighthawk corridor between Cheesman Dam and Strontia Springs, Waterton Canyon (hike-in only), then Denver urban corridor (River Run Park, Confluence Park). 15 APs, 3 impassable dams (Cheesman, Strontia Springs, Chatfield), 3 gauges.

accessPoints.name: Wigwam Club (private)
accessPoints.notes: Private fishing club immediately below Cheesman Dam; no public access.

accessPoints.name: Deckers
accessPoints.notes: Most popular Class II-III put-in. Deckers Chutes named rapid downstream.

accessPoints.name: Trumbull
accessPoints.notes: ~0.7 mi NE of Deckers; gauge site. Pike NF pullouts along Hwy 67.

accessPoints.name: Scraggy View
accessPoints.notes: Pike NF picnic area / SWA between Deckers and Nighthawk.

accessPoints.name: Nighthawk
accessPoints.notes: Hwy 67 pullout; mid-corridor.

accessPoints.name: South Platte (Foxton confluence)
accessPoints.notes: North Fork + South Platte confluence. End of Deckers-Nighthawk corridor.

accessPoints.name: Buffalo Creek Put-In (North Fork)
accessPoints.notes: North Fork section; multiple roadside pullouts on CR-96 / Hwy 285. Watch for No Trespassing.

accessPoints.name: Strontia Springs Dam outflow
accessPoints.notes: Top of Waterton Canyon; no public access at dam — Denver Water restricted.

accessPoints.name: Waterton Canyon Trailhead
accessPoints.notes: Off Waterton Rd, south of Chatfield. 6.2 mi hike/bike to Strontia Springs Dam — NO vehicle access. No dogs.

accessPoints.name: Chatfield State Park (S. Platte inflow)
accessPoints.notes: South Platte enters Chatfield Reservoir here.

accessPoints.name: Below Chatfield Dam (C-470)
accessPoints.notes: Tailwater put-in below Chatfield Dam; start of Denver urban corridor.

accessPoints.name: River Run Park
accessPoints.notes: Englewood/Sheridan WW play park.

accessPoints.name: Confluence Park
accessPoints.notes: Downtown Denver WW park at South Platte / Cherry Creek confluence. 100-yard course with two drops.
accessPoints.source: City of Denver; Confluence Kayaks; AW

accessPoints.name: Globeville Landing
accessPoints.notes: Lower Denver South Platte access on the Greenway.

accessPoints.name: Brighton (Bromley Lane)
accessPoints.notes: Brighton SWA / Bromley Lane bridge; downstream of Denver metro.

impassableDams.name: Cheesman Dam
impassableDams.notes: Denver Water; 221 ft granite arch-gravity dam. Separates Upper South Platte from Deckers corridor. Impassable.

impassableDams.name: Strontia Springs Dam
impassableDams.notes: Denver Water; 243 ft concrete double-curvature arch dam. Separates Deckers/Nighthawk corridor from Waterton Canyon.

impassableDams.name: Chatfield Dam
impassableDams.notes: USACE flood-control dam. Separates Waterton Canyon from Denver urban corridor.

gauges.name: South Platte below Brush Creek near Trumbull (Deckers)
South Platte below Union Ave at Englewood (River Run Park)
South Platte at Denver (near Confluence Park)

north-platte._summary: North Platte: only Colorado section is Northgate Canyon (North Park / Walden area) before entering Wyoming. 2 APs, 0 impassable dams, 1 gauge.

accessPoints.name: Routt Access
accessPoints.notes: USFS Medicine Bow-Routt; top of Northgate Canyon, just south of WY border. Concrete steps to ledge ~10 ft above river. Platte River Wilderness.
accessPoints.source: USFS MBR; AW (river-detail/2464); Wikipedia Northgate Canyon

accessPoints.name: Six Mile Gap (WY)
accessPoints.notes: BLM access in Wyoming ~6 mi north of CO border. Standard Northgate take-out.
